description: This file is a shell script (`log_buddyinfo.sh`) responsible for parsing and logging buddyinfo data related to CPU memory fragmentation, including managing system configurations and interacting with other system components like rpcclient and syscfg.

methods.name: parse_buddyinfo
methods.description: Parses buddyinfo data passed as an argument, extracts relevant information, updates system configuration, and logs telemetry data based on different zones such as Normal, DMA, DMA32, and HighMem.
